quotes.name: Benji Dillon
quotes.quote: To be honest, I've noticed people recognizing me more often around Rockridge and at the grocery store. It feels a bit surreal, but I'm trying to stay grounded. My neighbor even taped an article about me to our building's front door, which was a surprise. I'm just trying to keep doing what I do and not let it change me too much.

quotes.name: Anthony Raines
quotes.quote: Benji Dillon's a Rockridge icon, and his influence on the local culture is huge. I've seen it firsthand - people around here still talk about his games, his style. He's one of us, you know? The neighborhood loves him, and he loves it back. I've had conversations with him about the community, and he's always been passionate about giving back. His presence here isn't just about baseball; it's about being a part of the fabric of Rockridge.

quotes.name: Darrin Davis
quotes.quote: I've seen Benji Dillon's name popping up more often around the A's, and it's clear he's gaining traction. To be honest, I'm not super close to him, but you can tell when someone's rising through the ranks.
